description: Prevalence of iron overload by beer exposure and sex, plus ingested iron dose from traditional beer
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
from statsmodels.stats.proportion import proportion_confint

rows = [
 ("Rural Zimbabwe, male drinkers >45y\n(ferritin high + TSAT>70%)",23,111,"Exposed men","2872439"),
 ("Rural Zimbabwe, male spouses >1000 L\n(ferritin high + TSAT>70%)",4,28,"Exposed men","9058740"),
 ("Rural Zimbabwe/SA female drinkers\n(TSAT>55% + ferritin>400)",6,28,"Exposed women","10509769"),
 ("Rural Zimbabwe, female spouses >1000 L",0,28,"Exposed women","9058740"),
 ("Urban Zimbabwe autopsy, hepatic Fe >180 umol/g",7,134,"Mixed urban","10403742"),
 ("Zimbabweans on low dietary iron, raised ferritin",9,493,"Unexposed","19259672"),
]
d = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["cohort","k","n","group","pmid"])
d["p"]=d.k/d.n
ci=[proportion_confint(k,n,method='wilson') for k,n in zip(d.k,d.n)]
d["lo"]=np.clip([c[0] for c in ci],0,1); d["hi"]=[c[1] for c in ci]
m_k,m_n=d[d.group=="Exposed men"].k.sum(),d[d.group=="Exposed men"].n.sum()
w_k,w_n=d[d.group=="Exposed women"].k.sum(),d[d.group=="Exposed women"].n.sum()
u_k,u_n=d[d.group=="Unexposed"].k.sum(),d[d.group=="Unexposed"].n.sum()
or_mw,p_mw=stats.fisher_exact([[m_k,m_n-m_k],[w_k,w_n-w_k]])
or_mu,p_mu=stats.fisher_exact([[m_k,m_n-m_k],[u_k,u_n-u_k]])
beer_fe=46.0; vols=np.array([1,2,4,6,8]); daily=beer_fe*vols

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15.5,5))
cols={"Exposed men":"#9d0208","Exposed women":"#f48c06","Mixed urban":"#468faf","Unexposed":"#6c757d"}
o=d.sort_values("p").reset_index(drop=True); yy=np.arange(len(o))
xerr=np.vstack([np.clip((o.p-o.lo).values,0,None)*100, np.clip((o.hi-o.p).values,0,None)*100])
ax=axes[0]
ax.barh(yy,o.p*100,color=[cols[g] for g in o.group],alpha=.85)
ax.errorbar(o.p*100,yy,xerr=xerr,fmt='none',ecolor='k',elinewidth=1,capsize=3)
ax.set_yticks(yy); ax.set_yticklabels([f"{c}\n(n={n}, PMID {p})" for c,n,p in zip(o.cohort,o.n,o.pmid)],fontsize=7)
ax.set_xlabel("Iron overload prevalence (%), Wilson 95% CI")
ax.set_title("Prevalence tracks traditional-beer exposure",fontsize=10); ax.grid(axis='x',alpha=.3)

ax=axes[1]
groups=["Unexposed","Exposed women","Exposed men"]; ks=[u_k,w_k,m_k]; ns=[u_n,w_n,m_n]
ps=np.array([k/n for k,n in zip(ks,ns)]); lh=[proportion_confint(k,n,method='wilson') for k,n in zip(ks,ns)]
yerr=np.vstack([np.clip(ps-np.array([l for l,h in lh]),0,None)*100, np.clip(np.array([h for l,h in lh])-ps,0,None)*100])
ax.bar(groups,ps*100,color=[cols[g] for g in groups],alpha=.85)
ax.errorbar(groups,ps*100,yerr=yerr,fmt='none',ecolor='k',capsize=4)
for i,(k,n) in enumerate(zip(ks,ns)): ax.text(i,ps[i]*100+1.5,f"{k}/{n}",ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("Iron overload prevalence (%)")
ax.set_title(f"men vs women OR={or_mw:.1f} (p={p_mw:.2f})\nexposed men vs unexposed OR={or_mu:.0f} (p={p_mu:.0e})",fontsize=9)
ax.grid(axis='y',alpha=.3)

ax=axes[2]
ax.bar([f"{v} L/d" for v in vols],daily,color="#9d0208",alpha=.85)
ax.axhline(8,color='k',ls='--',lw=1.2); ax.text(0.0,9,"male RDA 8 mg/d",fontsize=8)
ax.axhline(45,color='#b35c00',ls='--',lw=1.2); ax.text(0.0,50,"tolerable upper limit 45 mg/d",fontsize=8,color='#b35c00')
ax.set_yscale('log'); ax.set_ylabel("Iron ingested (mg/day, log scale)")
ax.set_xlabel("Traditional beer consumed (46 mg Fe/L)")
ax.set_title("Ingested iron dose from traditional beer",fontsize=10); ax.grid(axis='y',alpha=.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print(f"Exposed men {m_k}/{m_n}={100*m_k/m_n:.1f}%, exposed women {w_k}/{w_n}={100*w_k/w_n:.1f}%, unexposed {u_k}/{u_n}={100*u_k/u_n:.1f}%")
print(f"men vs women OR={or_mw:.2f} p={p_mw:.3f}; exposed men vs unexposed OR={or_mu:.1f} p={p_mu:.2e}")
print(f"10,000 L lifetime beer = {10000*beer_fe/1000:.0f} g ingested Fe; 4.3% net absorption -> 20 g body burden")
